newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Mother and four children die in Dutch blaze.
newsitem.headline: Mother and four children die in Dutch blaze.

text.p: A mother and four of her children died when a fire destroyed their apartment in The Hague, police said on Wednesday.
Three of the woman's six surviving children were in a serious condition in hospital after the blaze, which erupted in the early hours of Wednesday morning.
A police spokeswoman said the bodies of the woman, 41, and four children aged between one and 12 were found in the apartment by fire fighters.
She said the woman's husband and three other children escaped the fire and were unhurt.
"We don't know how the fire started," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
